title: Traffic Monitoring System
description: Real-time traffic analysis and monitoring using computer vision and deep learning
longDescription: A comprehensive traffic monitoring solution that leverages computer vision algorithms and TensorFlow for real-time vehicle detection, counting, and traffic flow analysis. The system provides live dashboards and alerts for traffic management authorities.

title: AI Cyber Shield
description: NLP-powered system to detect fake offers and phishing attempts
longDescription: An intelligent cybersecurity tool that uses Natural Language Processing to analyze and detect fraudulent offers, phishing emails, and scam messages. Built with FastAPI backend and sophisticated ML models for high accuracy threat detection.

title: Jarvis AI Voice Assistant
description: Intelligent voice-controlled assistant with natural language understanding
longDescription: A sophisticated AI voice assistant inspired by Iron Man's Jarvis. Features voice recognition, natural language processing, and integration with OpenAI for intelligent responses. Supports task automation and smart home control.

title: Smart Kitchen Monitoring
description: IoT-based kitchen monitoring dashboard for smart appliances
longDescription: A modern React-based frontend for monitoring smart kitchen appliances. Integrates with IoT sensors to track temperature, humidity, gas levels, and appliance status. Features real-time alerts and energy consumption analytics.
